definitions.explanation: food preserved by soaking in vinegar, or the pickling method itself

examples.japanese: ⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{酢漬|すづ}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I made pickled vegetables in vinegar.

examples.japanese: きゅうり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{酢漬|すづ}け⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦さっぱりしている→さっぱりする：26802_sapparisuru⟧。
examples.english: Cucumbers pickled in vinegar have a refreshing taste.

examples.japanese: {酢漬|すづ}けにした{玉|たま}ねぎ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦サラダ→サラダ：01364_sarada⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: I add vinegar-pickled onions to the salad.

notes:
USAGE:
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{酢漬|すづ}け (~ pickled in vinegar)
- {酢漬|すづ}け⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to pickle in vinegar)

COMMON ITEMS:
- きゅうり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{酢漬|すづ}け (pickled cucumbers)
- {玉|たま}ねぎ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{酢漬|すづ}け (pickled onions)
- ⟦{生姜|しょうが}→生姜：05191_shouga⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{酢漬|すづ}け (pickled ginger)
- ニシン⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{酢漬|すづ}け (pickled herring)

RELATED PICKLE TYPES:
- ⟦{糠漬|ぬかづ}け→糠漬け：17712_nukazuke⟧ (rice bran pickles)
- ⟦{味噌漬|みそづ}け→味噌漬け：24781_misozuke⟧ (miso pickles)
- ⟦{粕漬|かすづ}け→粕漬け：08230_kasuzuke⟧ (sake lees pickles)
- ⟦{塩漬|しおづ}け→塩漬け：09008_shiozuke⟧ (salt pickles)
